dex.text: A stocky digger in a tin hat, who sees a wall and thinks 'this could do with a window'. It would rather go through a problem than round it, and it has left a lot of very neat holes.
dex.fact: During the Great Siege of Gibraltar, in 1782, Sergeant-Major Henry Ince of the Royal Military Artificers set about cutting a gallery through the Rock with hand tools and gunpowder, so that guns could fire down from the north face. By the Second World War the Rock held more than 50 kilometres of tunnels.
